title: Orbital occupancy in an iron cation
solution: Neutral Fe is $[\mathrm{Ar}]3d^64s^2$. Two 4s electrons leave to make $\ce{Fe^2+}$.
statement:
Which occupancy belongs to isolated $\ce{Fe^2+}$ in its ground state?

[_]{a}

explanations: Neutral Fe loses both highest-n 4s electrons.
It removes 3d electrons while keeping 4s filled.
